description: Independent reliability benchmark (see reports/claude_audit/independent_benchmark_design.md). Every expected value was computed straight from the supplied CSV files by benchmark_oracles.py, and equals the reference SQL result. Never read by runtime code; never copied into any prompt.

cases.question: On what date was the Tech Innovation Fund created?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT creation_date FROM portfolios WHERE portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund';

cases.question: List the company names of the Consumer Staples stocks.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.company_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Consumer Staples';

cases.question: What is the total quantity of Microsoft shares held across all portfolios?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(h.quantity) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE s.symbol = 'MSFT';

cases.question: Which sectors are represented among the stocks in the Balanced Portfolio?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT sec.sector_name FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN sectors sec ON sec.sector_id = s.sector_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Balanced Portfolio' AND s.asset_type = 'Stock';

cases.question: Among the high-risk portfolios, which one has the largest stated AUM? Give its name.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'High' ORDER BY total_aum DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: How many transactions took place last week?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2023-10-02' AND '2023-10-08';

cases.question: What is the highest Sharpe ratio on record? Give the value, the portfolio name and the date.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT pp.sharpe_ratio, p.portfolio_name, pp.performance_date FROM portfolio_performance pp JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id ORDER BY pp.sharpe_ratio DESC LIMIT 1;

cases.question: How is the Fixed Income Plus portfolio spread across sectors?
What is the sector exposure of the ESG Sustainable Fund?
Out of the portfolios with at least ten holdings, which has the most Energy exposure?
cases.sql_question: List the names of the portfolios that have at least ten holdings
cases.selection_sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.portfolio_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
